impersonation.title: Impersonation
impersonation.description: Every impersonation token issued by the server is tracked here. Active grants can be revoked — the token is rejected by the JWT validation hook within seconds.
impersonation.activeDescription: When an operator starts impersonating a tenant user, the session appears here in real time.
impersonation.historyDescription: Try a different status filter to see the rest of the grant history.

audits.title: Audit trail
audits.description: Every security action, entity change, and exception captured by the auditing pipeline. Filter by event type, severity, or correlation id to follow a request end-to-end.
audits.noMatch: No audit events match your filters.
audits.relaxFilter: Try clearing or relaxing a filter — the trail is broad by default.
audits.noTenantEvents: The audit pipeline hasn't recorded anything for this tenant yet.

webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.description: Subscribe HTTP endpoints to domain events. Payloads are signed with HMAC-SHA256 using the secret you provide — verify the X-FSH-Signature header on your side before trusting the body.
webhooks.emptyDescription: Add an endpoint and pick which events should fire. We'll retry failed deliveries automatically.
webhooks.notFound: Subscription not found. It may have been deleted.
webhooks.eventsDescription: Event types this endpoint subscribes to.
webhooks.noEvents: — no events; subscription would never fire
webhooks.deliveriesDescription: Recent attempts to POST events to this endpoint. Auto-refreshes every 10s.
webhooks.noDeliveries: No deliveries yet. Try the test button above, or wait for matching events to fire.

health.title: Health
health.description: Live process and dependency probes. Auto-refreshes every {{seconds}} seconds. Probe endpoints are unauthenticated so they can be scraped by load balancers and uptime monitors.
health.livenessDescription: Process is up and serving requests. No external dependencies are checked.
health.readinessDescription: All registered dependency checks must report Healthy for the probe to return 200. A 503 here flips the API out of the load-balancer pool.

dashboard.description: Operate every tenant on this instance — identity, multitenancy, billing, and the rest of the system surface.
dashboard.invoicesDescription: Cross-tenant ledger. Issue, mark paid, void.

billing.filtersDescription: All filters are AND-combined. Period is matched exactly (year + month).

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Define what people can do. Each role bundles a set of permissions; users inherit a role's permissions by being assigned to it.
roles.noMatch: Nothing matches “{{term}}”. Try a different term.
roles.createFirst: Create your first role to start bundling permissions.
roles.name: Name
roles.detailDescription: Inspect and edit this role's profile and permission grants.

tenants.title: Registry
tenants.emptyDescription: Provision the first tenant to get started.
tenants.impersonateTitle: Sign in as a user inside this tenant
tenants.renewTitle: Extend validity by one plan term, or switch plans
tenants.adjustTitle: Set the expiry date directly with no invoice (operator override)
tenants.detailsDescription: The tenant's identity, contact, and subscription window. Identifiers are immutable; the issuer scopes JWTs to this tenant.
tenants.name: Name
tenants.provisioningDescription: Live status of the background pipeline that seeds the tenant database, default roles, and admin user. Polls every 2 seconds while running.

users.title: Directory
users.adjustFilters: Adjust filters or invite a new user.
users.firstMember: Register the first member to seed this tenant.
users.identityDescription: Account identifiers and contact details captured at registration.
users.pendingChanges: {{count}} pending change{{suffix}} — review and save when ready.
users.toggleRolesDescription: Tap any role to toggle. Changes are batched — review and save when ready.
users.noRoles: No roles defined for this tenant.

account.signOutDescription: You'll need to sign in again to access this admin. Any unsaved work in this session will be lost.

errors.validationFailed: One or more validation errors occurred.
errors.unexpected: An unexpected error occurred. Please try again later.
